mapper.sql: FROM repair_shop s JOIN region d ON d.level=3 AND d.enabled AND s.address LIKE ('广东省深圳市'||d.name||'%') JOIN region c ON c.id=d.parent_id AND c.code='440300' AND c.enabled WHERE s.code LIKE 'AMAP-%'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.name,s.address,s.contact_phone,d.id AS district_id,d.name AS district ORDER BY s.name,s.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT s.id,s.name,s.address,s.contact_phone,d.id AS district_id,d.name AS district AND s.id=#{id}
SELECT s.id,s.name,s.address,s.contact_phone,d.id AS district_id,d.name AS district AND s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF s
